digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and destructive-repair pause coordination
propositions: Bridge execution must route through a single packaged Python core entrypoint (rebar bridge run) across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments without requiring repository-local runner scripts
Legacy reconcile callers using rebar reconcile --mode must retain their published defaults, exit behavior, and mutation boundaries without breaking
Destructive-repair pause ownership for fsck --repair and doctor --repair must be provider-neutral, durable, and use git refs (refs/reconciler/gate) without GitHub CLI dependency

The no-GitHub-CLI constraint is verified by tests/scripts/graph/test_repair_pause_ownership.py rejecting subprocess argv beginning with gh, running destructive repair successfully, and asserting gh_calls == []
Checked-out workflows and environments using legacy reconcile modes must continue to operate unchanged
Provider-neutral pause safety must read existing pause snapshot, call set_pause, and clear only observed OID through release with ref_lock.GATE_REF
